prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Specify a multistep iPhone event-creation sheet. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. Event flow needs title, date and invitees. Prototype shows Cancel, Back and Done together on every step; Done is enabled when title is empty and swipe dismissal discards a partially entered event. Editing is a brief task tied to the calendar.

criteria.task_completion: Define coherent first/intermediate/final controls, suitable size/detents and common dirty-exit resolution with title/validation/focus behavior; distinguish Back from dismissal.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the sheets guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Define coherent first/intermediate/final controls, suitable size/detents and common dirty-exit resolution with title/validation/focus behavior; distinguish Back from dismissal.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Define coherent first/intermediate/final controls, suitable size/detents and common dirty-exit resolution with title/validation/focus behavior; distinguish Back from dismissal.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
